title: Kolaviron influences calf thymus DNA conformational stability and structural dynamics: a multi-spectroscopic and molecular dynamics analysis.
authors: Ochima, Oluseyi V; Kolawole, Adejoke N; Falese, Babatunde A; Ayenero, Michael E; Kolawole, Ayodele O
one_liner_zh: 该文通过光谱与分子动力学模拟研究黄酮类化合物与ctDNA小沟结合机制，属广义蛋白-DNA互作体系，但对象为小分子-DNA而非TF-DNA，方法可迁移但匹配度中等。
abstract: Kolaviron, flaunted for its anticancer potential, has driven our exploration of its mechanism of interaction with DNA, and further shedding light on its therapeutic promise. Herein, the binding efficacy and thermodynamics of kolaflavanone, a component of kolaviron, with double-stranded calf thymus DNA (ctDNA), were investigated using a range of spectroscopic techniques and molecular docking simulations. Syllogistically, spectroscopic techniques, viscometric analysis, and thermal denaturation revealed that kolaflavanone binds to the double-stranded ctDNA minor groove via electrostatic interactions, with binding constants of 10(5) L.mol(-1). The interaction was both enthalpically and entropically driven, with a DeltaH value of -18.16 kJ/mol and a DeltaS value of 38.60 J/mol/K at 25  degrees C. This resulted in subtle but negligible structural perturbations of the ctDNA native B-conformation. ctDNA has one binding site for the flavonoid. Molecular docking and dynamics simulation analyses confirmed that kolaflavanone binds to the minor groove of DNA with a preference for the A-T region and a binding affinity of -7.4 kcal/mol. The conjugate's stability, conferred by minor groove binding and non-intercalative interactions, suggests a promising strategy for designing DNA-targeted therapeutics with enhanced stability and tumor-specific gene regulation potential.
abstract_zh: Kolaviron，以其抗癌潜力而备受推崇，促使我们探索其与DNA相互作用的机制，并进一步阐明其治疗前景。在此，我们利用一系列光谱技术和分子对接模拟，研究了kolaviron的一种成分kolaflavanone与双链小牛胸腺DNA（ctDNA）的结合效率和热力学性质。综合而言，光谱技术、粘度分析和热变性实验揭示，kolaflavanone通过静电相互作用结合到双链ctDNA的小沟上，结合常数为10(5) L·mol(-1)。该相互作用同时受焓和熵驱动，在25摄氏度下，ΔH值为-18.16 kJ/mol，ΔS值为38.60 J/mol/K。这导致ctDNA天然B构象发生细微但可忽略的结构扰动。ctDNA对该黄酮类化合物具有一个结合位点。分子对接和动力学模拟分析证实，kolaflavanone结合到DNA小沟，偏好A-T区域，结合亲和力为-7.4 kcal/mol。该结合物通过小沟结合和非嵌入相互作用获得的稳定性，提示了一种设计具有增强稳定性和肿瘤特异性基因调控潜力的DNA靶向治疗药物的有前景策略。
